packageRules.description: Capability crates are exact git revisions bumped deliberately and together (one rev per repository, [patch.crates-io] aligned; see AGENTS.md and scripts/check_capability_pins.py). Per-crate digest PRs always fail that check, and a grouped Renovate PR cannot keep the [patch.crates-io] entries and the transitive foundation requirements aligned. Cargo git dependencies use the git-refs datasource with the repository URL as packageName; the earlier matchSourceUrls rule did not match them (PRs #56, #80, #81).
